prompt: Which of these animals lives in the sea?
explanation: The blue whale lives in the ocean. It is the largest animal that has ever lived on Earth — as long as about three school buses and as heavy as 200 tons — yet it eats tiny sea creatures called krill. Dogs, robins, and rabbits all live on land.
